title: Reconcile records while preserving both unmatched sides
goal: Find matched, missing and unexpected records in one reconciliation without losing entries from either input.

selectionNotes: FullJoin retains both unmatched sides; duplicate keys produce every matching pair.
Async joins build a lookup; they are not an unbounded constant-memory stream transform.
Queryable availability does not establish database-provider translation.
